responsibility: This definition module declares a tiny time-formatting helper that copies the current time into a caller-supplied character buffer. It belongs to the gm2 runtime utility layer and exports GetTimeString as a simple ARRAY OF CHAR interface for obtaining a textual timestamp.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the declaration side of the TimeString pair, exporting only the GetTimeString procedure for a caller-provided character array; TimeString.mod contains the concrete wrapc.strtime call and bounded copy/nul-termination logic.
